Nigeria defender Calvin Bassey could be an ideal fit for Barcelona, with former Fulham player Javi Pereira insisting the full back possesses qualities missing from Hansi Flick’s defensive options, PUNCH Sports Extra reports. Speaking to Marca (h/t Mundo Deportivo), Pereira made a strong case for the 26-year-old, highlighting his physical strength, recovery speed and ability to drive the ball forward. Although Bassey has not emerged as a concrete Barcelona transfer target, Pereira believes his profile addresses some of the club’s needs as they seek to strengthen their defence. “I honestly believe that Barcelona don’t have a centre-back like Bassey. He has a distinct physical and athletic profile, something Flick is lacking in important matches. “He can play in a high defensive line, knows how to push forward, is aggressive in the opposition’s half and has great top speed. He could play,” Pereira said. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources The former Fulham player believes Bassey’s athleticism would offer Barcelona a different defensive dimension, particularly when operating with a high defensive line. His versatility is another quality Pereira believes could appeal to the Spanish giants. Having started his career as a left-back, Bassey can operate in different defensive positions and provide cover across the left side. “What’s more, he plays every game and hardly ever gets injured. Bassey started out as a left-back, so he’d also be adaptable to playing in a back three or, as Barcelona do, starting with three at the back. “In that case, he could cover the entire left flank. What’s more, he’d bring versatility: he could fill in at full-back, like Gerard Martin at times,” Pereira noted. Pereira also highlighted Bassey’s ability to progress the ball, describing it as another asset that could fit into Barcelona’s possession-based approach. The Nigerian is comfortable receiving possession under pressure and driving into midfield, offering an alternative to building attacks through short passes. “Fulham are a team who build up play from the back and Bassey is very reliable with his passing. “He has something else that Barcelona, with the exception of Pau Cubarsi, don’t have: the ability to break through defences with his dribbling. He’s one of the best in the Premier League in this regard. “If they shut down Pedri or Rodri… he’d be capable of picking up the ball and driving into the opposition’s half. He has no qualms about it. That would give him another string to his bow.” Barcelona are assessing centre-back options ahead of the January transfer window as Flick looks to strengthen his defensive resources. However, Bassey has not been identified as a concrete target in reports surrounding the club’s search. The Nigerian is in his fourth season at Craven Cottage and has established himself as an important member of Fulham’s defence and leader under Alvaro Arbeloa. He was named the club’s Player of The Season for the 2024/25 campaign.
